subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should the gateway restart-drain bypass become a public plugin SDK/queue contract, or must it stay internal to OpenClaw-owned restart recovery?
rationale: The PR can plausibly fix message loss, but exposing enqueueInternal and drain-bypass options changes the plugin compatibility and shutdown admission boundary, which automation cannot choose safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep bypass internal
options.body: Require the PR to hide the bypass from public SDK-facing types and keep restart-drain authority inside internal runtime code before merge.

options.title: Approve public contract
options.body: Accept the new SDK behavior deliberately, with docs and compatibility tests proving third-party plugins can use it safely.

options.title: Route to durable recovery
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers prefer the broader SQLite-backed restart recovery design to own the remaining message-loss work.

recommendation.title: Keep bypass internal
recommendation.body: Require the PR to hide the bypass from public SDK-facing types and keep restart-drain authority inside internal runtime code before merge.
